This surgery is conveniently located with sufficient parking. The receptionists are friendly, but there seems to be a high turnover of GPs, which isn't ideal.
Overall, the surgery functions well with its online prescription service being particularly useful. However, the experience lacks a personal touch, which could make a big difference in patient care.
Appointments are generally available within a few days, which is convenient. However, the consultations often feel rushed, with little time to discuss concerns in depth.
The waiting area is clean and has enough seating, but it could use more current magazines or a children's corner to make waits more comfortable, especially when delays occur.
The online booking system is user-friendly and a great option for making appointments. Still, it occasionally experiences downtime, which can be frustrating.
The staff at the front desk are efficient at handling check-ins and paperwork. Sometimes, though, their responses can seem curt due to the busy nature of their work.
Repeat prescriptions can be requested online, which is highly convenient. Yet, there are times when the turnaround time for a prescription is longer than expected.
The clinic offers a Good range of services and the general practice nurses are attentive. However, more specialized services require a referral and waiting times can be lengthy.
Parking is ample, making access to the clinic easy. Inside, however, the signage could be improved to better direct patients to different sections of the practice.
The healthcare assistants are diligent in taking vital signs and preparing patients. While they are professional, the interaction often lacks a personal touch.

The practice usually sends reminders for appointments and follow-ups, which is helpful. However, the communication could be more detailed, especially regarding what to expect at upcoming appointments.
The surgery is well-maintained and modern, but the atmosphere is somewhat clinical and impersonal. A warmer, more welcoming environment could enhance patient comfort.
Telephone consultations are an available option, which is great for quick discussions. The downside is that it's sometimes difficult to convey more complex issues over the phone.
